content.title: Duke vs. St. John's radio coverage: Station, channel, streaming to listen live to March Madness Sweet 16 broadcast
content.text: Cameron and Cayden BoozerDuke vs. St. John's radio coverage: Station, channel, streaming to listen live to March Madness Sweet 16 broadcast originally appeared on The Sporting News. Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here.AdvertisementFriday's slate of Sweet 16 games will tip off with a highly anticipated matchup between No. 1 Duke and No. 5 St. John's.Duke beat Siena and TCU in the previous rounds behind back-to-back double-doubles from freshman star Cameron Boozer. Jon Scheyer and the Blue Devils are hoping to advance to the Elite Eight for the third straight season.St. John's advanced to the Sweet 16 for the first time since 1999 after Dylan Darling hit a buzzer-beating layup against Kansas. Can the Red Storm pull off the upset against the Blue Devils?Here is everything you need to know in order to listen to Duke vs. St. John's in the 2026 NCAA Tournament.AdvertisementListen to every game of the 2026 NCAA men's basketball tournament live on SiriusXM. The Duke vs. St. John's broadcast will be available on channel 201.New subscribers can listen to SiriusXM for free for four months.
